records.rationale: The per-level/per-source filter toggle is an outlined pill with an active/inactive visual state and an aria-pressed toggle contract -- Button/IconButton have no pill-shaped toggle variant, and this is the only raw native control in this file (the rest of the tree uses Panel/PanelHeader/Button/ScrollRegion/EmptyState).
records.reviewCondition: a shared toggle-pill primitive is added to the design system
